title: modbus-simulator expectation v1
description: Trace assertion file for modbus-simulator assert-trace. Matching is subset (partial): only fields present in a matcher are compared. ts, durationMs, and raw are never matched.

schemaVersion.description: Expectation format version. Must be exactly modbus-simulator.expect.v1.

assertions.description: Assertions evaluated in order. All must pass for exit code 0.

assertion.description: One assertion of a supported kind.

kind.description: contains/notContains: match presence. count: match count bounds. ordered: subsequence in relative order. exact: record count equals sequence length and positional subset match.

match.description: Subset matcher for contains, notContains, and count.

sequence.description: Ordered list of subset matchers for ordered and exact kinds.

equals.description: For count: require exactly this many matching records.

atLeast.description: For count: require at least this many matching records.

atMost.description: For count: require at most this many matching records.

matcher.description: Subset matcher against one trace record. request/response match when every specified field equals the record. stateChange matches if any element of the record stateChanges array matches all specified fields.

request.description: Partial request object to match (e.g. fc, area, address, quantity, value, values).

response.description: Partial response object to match (e.g. ok, values, exceptionCode, fault).

stateChange.description: Partial state change to match against any entry in the record stateChanges array (e.g. area, address, after).
